name: Windweaver
description:
About This Game

Jonathan can't fly anymore - so he learned to go run. Windweaver is a high-octane, boost-style 3D platformer about ripping through breathtaking landscapes at breakneck speed, riding the wind, and never, ever losing your momentum.

No wings. No brakes. Just you, the wind, and the world. As you travel, you may begin to discover the truth of this world, and that everything is not as it was told to you...

Speed Is Everything

Chain together massive dashes, blitz across enormous gaps, and outmaneuver everything in your path. Read the rhythm of the sloped terrain to hold your top speed, then shatter your limits with a deep, expressive movement toolkit:

  • DASH - burn wind energy to rocket forward across the ground, through the air, and even along walls.

  • DIVE - fling yourself back towards the ground, for quick manuevers and downward force.

  • FALLCHARGE - charge up your wind energy, and get going again if ever slowed down.

  • WALLRUN - weave through tight, high-speed wallrunning sections like a pro.

Build Your Perfect Playstyle

Equip Pins to completely reshape how Jonathan moves. Go all-in on raw speed with the Slipstream Pin, keep yourself up high with the Bounce Pin, build unstoppable speed with the Speed Pin, and mix and match dozens of various pins and effects. Swing by the Blacksmith to upgrade your Pins, growing ever stronger and ever faster.

A World Bursting With Life

Between the high-speed stages lies a vibrant world full of characters. From the humble town of Dyebrook, to the peaks of Copper Cliffs, take on side quests, run wild errands, and chase down the truth the mysterious beam of light that took you down.

So Many Ways To Go Fast

  • Time Attack - chase faster splits and climb from E rank all the way to the elusive W.

  • Rival Races - go head-to-head against the world's most colorful characters.

  • Seed Hoarder - high-speed collection runs that test your routing.

  • Boss Showdowns - adrenaline-fueled chases with explosive quick-time finishes.

Race Your Friends Online

Take your skills to your friends or the world. Jump into multiplayer lobbies, vote on stages and game modes, and race other Windweavers in real time

The Journey Ahead

Windweaver is a high-speed 3D platformer built in Unity, and we're pushing hard toward a playable demo and public Steam playtest. Our core mechanics are locked in and the world is coming alive.

Wishlist now and follow along for development roadmaps, early alpha footage, and major milestone reveals as we race toward release. The wind is waiting.
short_desc: Windweaver is a blisteringly fast 3D platformer - chain together abilities to tear your way across a vast world to get back home, whilst learning that the truth of the world may not be as it was told... Master dashing, diving, fall-charging and various abilities to traverse many hand-crafted levels.
